allowed: expose approved exact private Blob versions for Internal Audit pull

authentication.tokens: Separate managed identities; exact issuer/tenant/audience/lifetime/app role. Token producer tenant/object must equal trusted producer and purpose-specific signer mapping.
authentication.purposeKeys: Four separate purposes: workload submission, workload audit, Internal Audit receipt, Internal Audit verdict. Exact algorithms/key versions come from approved policy/registry; none invented.
authentication.denial: Missing, unavailable, expired, not-yet-valid, rotated-out, revoked, compromised, wrong-purpose, token/signer mismatch or signature/hash failure denies.
authentication.management: Internal Audit deployment/build/release/operations identities are separate from delivery/workload identities and PIM-controlled.

rules: Exact role plus workload identity allow-list and subject scope
delivery has no verdict/receipt write role
Internal Audit admin object IDs are owner supplied
role evidence required before route admission

privateNetworking: Internal assurance API/evaluator/receiver in assurance VNet with no public ingress/egress.
Internal Audit evidence reader reaches allow-listed source Blob private endpoints through approved DNS/path and exact version requests; no SAS, redirect or arbitrary URL.
Assurance SQL, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, ACR and Monitor use approved private endpoints/DNS and public access disabled where supported.
Evaluator sandbox has no public egress or management-plane route; only explicitly authorised private dependencies.
Workload-to-assurance management plane and image push are denied.
dataProtection: TLS 1.2 or later; platform encryption at rest unless separately approved CMK decision.
Manifests/messages carry references and hashes, not document/prompt/completion bodies.
Immutable storage, legal hold and retention are Internal Audit-owned; no duration invented.
Logs allow-list correlation/hash metadata and exclude tokens, signatures and sensitive bodies.
auditability: Preserve role, private-path, signature, hash-chain, receipt, immutability and binding evidence.
Missing receipt or final signed verdict cannot be inferred as success.
complianceBoundary: Technical evidence controls only; no legal conclusion, certification, attestation, waiver or phase approval. Existing residual controls remain open.

failClosedOwnerEvidence.evidence: signed provisioning, RBAC, private DNS/path, key policy, retention/legal hold, recovery and capacity records
versioned registry approval, deployment/model/provider terms, evaluation, quota/capability, safety and limits evidence
queue ownership/RBAC/private path, thresholds and poison/recovery approval

verificationCriteria: Negative RBAC proves no workload verdict mutation/assurance admin.
Public path fails and approved private identity/path succeeds.
Manifest/message tamper, signature/role mismatch, duplicate conflict and missing parameter fail closed.
No secrets/sensitive bodies in templates, configuration or telemetry.
Negative SSRF, redirect, public path and Blob version-swap tests
Token/signer mapping, expiry/revocation/compromise and cross-purpose key negative tests
Cross-tenant/case retrieval, caller-filter override, prompt injection, citation spoof and poisoned-index tests
Workload image push/assurance administration and receipt-row fabrication denied
Sandbox management-plane, secret and public-egress denial
hostileContentAndIsolation: All submitted artifacts untrusted until private pull, exact-version verification, scan and WORM copy.
Static verification default; dynamic execution separately authorised.
Ephemeral non-root immutable-image sandbox with read-only copied input, no secrets, bounded CPU/memory/time/process/object/temp and destruction after result.
Instruction/data separation, injection controls, tenant/case server filters, provenance and known-good index alias required.
Unavailable control or sandbox never produces PASS.
